package fixture

import (
	. "os/exec"
	"testing"
)

// os/exec is dot-imported for its types; Command here is a local function
// that records the name and starts nothing.
func TestDotImportShadow(t *testing.T) {
	var _ *Cmd
	var started []string
	Command := func(name string) { started = append(started, name) }
	Command("luau")
	if len(started) != 1 {
		t.Fatal(started)
	}
}
